narrative_passages.title: Musa and Pharaoh at the sea

summary_for_children: Surah Yunus shows signs in the sun and moon, tells how people call on Allah at sea, and remembers the people of Yunus who believed.
environment_concept: A terrace of the moon's phases for counting the months (10:5), a ship at sea (10:22), a garden in the rain (10:24) and a doorway to Yunus's story (10:98).
architecture_and_scenery: Seaside cliffs, a harbour, a ship on open water, a garden above the shore, and a night sky for moon phases.

palette.atmosphere: Sea spray, storm wind then calm

areas.name: Moon Phase Terrace
areas.description: A terrace marking the moon's phases.

areas.name: Storm at Sea
areas.description: A ship in a storm that grows calm.

areas.name: Garden of Rain
areas.description: Rain makes the garden bloom, then fade.

areas.name: Doorway of Yunus
areas.description: A doorway to the Yunus story world.

activities.name: Count the months
activities.description: Lay five numbered stones in order, counting as the moon does.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Calm the sail
activities.description: Hold the ship steady through a storm while reading 10:22.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: The narrator keeps the sea scenes as setting, and the doorway leads to the Yunus story.
learning_objectives: Explain moon phases as a sign
Know that the people of Yunus believed

status.playable_environment: first version built: a composed world (arch, cloud, moons, orchard, ships) with 1 hands-on activity in the scene
status.testing: not tested yet: written and type-checked, not yet checked on screen

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

adventure_world.title: The Ocean of Signs
adventure_world.source: "Quran Adventure: First 10 Unique Worlds" with the rule "114 unique game experiences" (2026-11-04); replaces the first adventure version built from the earlier design table
adventure_world.status: second version built for the web: each world now has its own core mechanic; draft, unreviewed; checked in headless Chromium with software WebGL only, not on phones or real GPUs
adventure_world.note: The new-look adventure world for this surah. It is a separate design from the composed scene this record describes; both are kept until reviewers choose.
adventure_world.core_play: A sailing adventure: steer your own boat round the bay and out to sea, to five places where the sea, the sky and the stories of earlier peoples are read.

unique_world.visual_theme: Island town and open sea with a storm leg

primary_mechanic.text: Board a boat at the dock and sail to five stops, one through a storm (10:22-23).

secondary_activities: shore reading 21:87-88 (the fish account is not in surah 10)
unique_world.learning_objective: Remembering Allah in ease as in hardship (10:22-23)
